The Thermo Scientific Nexsa G2 is a high-performance X-ray Photoelectron Spectrometer, designed to integrate other analytical techniques whilst maintaining a high-throughput workflow. With unique options such as the Thermo Scientific™ MAGCIS™ dual-mode ion source and the Thermo Scientific™ iXR™ Raman Spectrometer, the Nexsa G2 system is ready for the toughest surface analysis problems.
The Nexsa G2 Surface Analysis System helps you achieve understanding – quickly and easily. With an updated X-ray monochromator, coupled with a high-efficiency spectrometer, the instrument can collect high-quality data quickly, even for small feature analysis.
Beyond XPS, the Nexsa G2 system offers the ability to add complementary analysis capabilities, including the unique iXR Raman Spectrometer. This multi-technique functionality means that multi-dimensional data can be acquired from the same point, during the same experiment, automatically. 
Discover the Nexsa G2 Surface Analysis System 
Download the Brochure Here
The new version of the Avantage software manages all the experimental control, data acquisition, data processing and reporting. Avantage makes sure that collecting complex data sets is easy; just choose the analysis points from the optical view or an XPS image, define the analysis (or let the system do it for you with the auto-analysis function), and get going – speeding your journey from question to answer.
